title: Build a CosmWasm staking rewards dashboard
description: We need a read-only web dashboard that queries staking rewards across multiple XION validators and displays historical APR, claimable rewards, and compounding projections. The UI should be responsive and match our existing brand kit (provided on acceptance).
deliverables: Source code in a private GitHub repo (transferred on completion)
Live deployment on Cloudflare Pages or Vercel
Basic README covering local dev setup
